purpose: Validate named-zone identifiers against PostgreSQL tzdb and validate local/resolved instant consistency, including only the two explicit Temporal-compatible resolutions of a DST gap while preserving source wall-clock intent.

state_history.material_state_behavior: Validates timezone-dependent material payloads without owning semantic state; for named-zone Schedule placement it keeps source local coordinates distinct from accepted resolved instants.
state_history.immutability_policy: Immediate validator only; invalid/missing IANA identifiers use SQLSTATE 22023 and unsupported local/resolved combinations fail closed.

obligations: exact round-trip local/resolved consistency where applicable
DST-gap resolved instants are limited to the two explicit supported alternatives
source wall-clock intent remains distinct from resolved instant
